heading: Practice areas
intro: Advice and representation across the legal matters that individuals, families and businesses face most often.

areas.title: Corporate and commercial advisory
areas.description: Business formation, governance, shareholder and commercial agreements, and day-to-day counsel for growing enterprises.

areas.title: Contracts and transactions
areas.description: Drafting, review and negotiation of agreements that protect your position and reduce risk down the line.

areas.title: Dispute resolution
areas.description: Negotiation, mediation, arbitration and litigation support, chosen to fit what you need from the outcome.

areas.title: Property and real estate
areas.description: Due diligence, title checks, leases and sale or purchase agreements for owners, tenants and investors.

areas.title: Family and succession
areas.description: Discreet guidance on family matters, wills, estates and succession planning.

areas.title: Employment and compliance
areas.description: Employment contracts, workplace policies, regulatory compliance and internal reviews.

steps.title: Confidential consultation
steps.description: You describe your situation in confidence and we agree on what matters most.

steps.title: Assessment and strategy
steps.description: Your options, risks and likely outcomes are set out plainly, with a recommended course of action.

steps.title: Action and representation
steps.description: Documents are drafted, negotiations are held and, where needed, your case is taken forward formally.

steps.title: Resolution and follow-up
steps.description: The matter is closed carefully, with clear next steps and ongoing support if you need it.
